title: Australian Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew with an Australian twist, featuring tender chunks of beef and a rich, spicy broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, beef broth, red wine (if using), and spicy sauce.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or thyme).
